newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordanian pleads not guilty in schoolgirl killings.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian pleads not guilty in schoolgirl killings.

text.p: A Jordanian soldier charged with premeditated murder of seven Israeli schoolgirls in March pleaded not guilty at the opening session of his military trial on Tuesday.
Ahmed al-Daqamsa listened from a black cage as charges including premeditated murder and military disobedience were read out in the courtroom on a military base a few miles (km) south of Amman.
"Do you understand the charges?" asked Brigadier Mamoun al-Khasawneh, head of a five-man tribunal of military judges.
Daqamsa's lawyer says he confessed to shooting the teenage girls on a school trip to the border region of Baqoura, but that he acted impulsively after they teased him while he was praying.
The prosecution said Daqamsa had planned for years to kill Israelis and had volunteered extra guard duties so he would have an opportunity to strike.
